open_points.subject: pre-export room-name correction
open_points.text: “the owner, before making the export on the VPS (R0-72), corrects there every room name” conflicts with “a room is never renamed or removed afterwards (R0-10)”
open_points.question: Is the pre-export correction an explicit one-time exception to room-name immutability, or must non-compliant rooms be handled without renaming them?
options: Make pre-export correction a one-time exception to R0-10
Exclude every project containing a non-compliant room name
Recreate rooms under compliant names and define what happens to their identities and links
open_points.default_guess: Treat the pre-export correction as a narrowly scoped one-time exception that preserves each room id.

witness.initial: A VPS project selected for import has an existing room named “Bathroom for María's wheelchair”.
events: The owner identifies that the room name breaks R0-96.
The owner prepares the project for export.
outcomes: R0-96 requires the owner to rename the room before export.
R0-10 forbids renaming the room after its creation.
witness.observer: The owner and every consumer that reads the room name

open_points.subject: archived projects in the migration
open_points.text: “corrects there every room name of the projects to be picked that breaks this rule” conflicts, for an archived project, with “An archived project ... cannot be corrected (R0-12)”
open_points.question: May the owner correct room names in an archived source project before export, and if so is this a migration-only exception to archive finality?
options: Permit a migration-only correction of room names in archived source projects
Exclude archived projects with non-compliant room names
Import such archived projects unchanged despite the writer rule
open_points.default_guess: Permit a migration-only correction that changes only the room name and preserves archive status and identities.

witness.initial: An archived VPS project selected for import contains a room name that breaks R0-96.
events: The owner checks the selected project's room names.
The owner attempts to make the required correction before export.
outcomes: The new passage requires the correction.
R0-12 refuses correction of the archived project.
witness.observer: The owner performing the migration and later readers of the imported room

open_points.subject: VPS room-name correction action
open_points.text: “the owner ... corrects there every room name”
open_points.question: What concrete source-side action performs this correction, what inputs does it take, what observable success output does it produce, and how does it fail without leaving a partial or corrupt migration source?
options: Add a dedicated one-time correction mode to the migration script
Use an existing v1 owner/API action and name it
Define a controlled direct-store migration procedure
Do not mutate the source; transform names in the export after owner confirmation
open_points.default_guess: Add a one-time migration-script preparation step that accepts room id and replacement name, preserves all ids and links, reports every changed room, and aborts on any failure.

open_points.subject: project selection before export
open_points.text: “before making the export ... every room name of the projects to be picked” while R0-79 says “At the import the owner picks any subset of its projects”
open_points.question: When does the selected subset become fixed, and what prevents the owner from selecting at import a project whose room names were not checked before export?
options: Fix and record the subset before correction and export
Check every project included in the export so any subset remains selectable at import
Let import restrict selection to projects recorded as checked
Allow unchecked projects to be selected and accepted
open_points.default_guess: Fix the subset before correction, include that recorded subset in the export, and allow import to select only from it.

witness.initial: The VPS contains projects A and B; only A is expected to be imported, so only A's rooms are checked.
events: The owner exports both projects using the source export format.
At import, the owner changes the selection from A to B.
outcomes: R0-79 permits choosing B at import.
The new passage assumes every picked project's room names were already checked, but B's were not.
witness.observer: The owner and an agent that later receives B's room names

open_points.subject: integrity between checking and export
open_points.text: “The import then copies names the owner has already checked”
open_points.question: How is it guaranteed that the names exported are the exact names the owner checked, if a room can be added or source data can change after the check and before the export is captured?
options: Freeze source writes from the start of checking through export
Make the correction/check operate on the immutable export artifact
Record checked room ids and names and have the exporter verify an exact match
Accept that unchecked names may enter the import
open_points.default_guess: Generate the export first, have the owner review and correct a staged immutable copy, and import exactly that reviewed artifact.

witness.initial: The owner has checked all rooms currently in selected project A.
events: After the check, another source-side action adds a room or changes stored source data.
The owner runs the export script.
Production imports the resulting file without inspecting room-name content.
outcomes: The implementation treats the earlier check as sufficient and imports the new unchecked name.
The implementation detects that the exported room set or names differ from the checked set and stops.
witness.observer: The owner and the agent that receives the newly imported room name
